newsitem.title: YEMEN: Britain to discuss French Zaire force proposal.
newsitem.headline: Britain to discuss French Zaire force proposal.

text.p: British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind said on Tuesday Britain would discuss French President Jacques Chirac's idea of a multilateral force for Zaire at a summit between the two nations on Friday.

"President Chirac has put forward a very important proposal. The United Kingdom and France will be having a summit meeting in France on Friday this week and therefore we have the opportunity to discuss this," Rifkind said during a visit to Yemen.
"We share with France and many other countries a deep concern about the deterioration of the situation in Zaire and Rwanda," Rifkind said.

France is championing a military intervention in eastern Zaire to save the lives of the refugees, mainly Hutus who fled Rwanda two years ago after the Hutu genocide of up to one million Tutsis and other victims in their homeland.
African leaders held their first summit on the war in eastern Zaire on Tuesday as 1.2 million refugees in the region faced a growing threat of famine.
Zaire boycotted the Nairobi summit, dimming hopes of any diplomatic way out of the impasse -- how to reach the refugees and avert catastrophe.
